tagline: First Financial Bankshares, Inc. is a financial holding company that generates revenue primarily from interest on loans and investments, trust fees, and service charges on deposit accounts.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net interest margin is a key profitability indicator for banks, reflecting the efficiency with which they manage their interest-bearing assets relative to their liabilities.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between the interest revenues generated by a bank's assets and the interest paid on its liabilities.
kpis.description: Measures the difference between interest revenues earned on loans and investments and interest paid on deposits and other financing.

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measures a bank's operational efficiency by comparing its non-interest expenses to its total revenue.
kpis.description: Calculated by dividing non-interest expenses by the sum of net interest income (on a fully taxable basis) and non-interest revenues.

kpis.name: Return on Average Assets (ROAA)
kpis.explanation: Measures a bank's profitability relative to its total assets.
kpis.description: Indicates how much a bank earns for each dollar of assets it holds.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of overall banking performance.

kpis.name: Return on Average Equity (ROAE)
kpis.explanation: Measures a bank's profitability relative to its shareholders' equity.
kpis.description: Indicates the return generated on shareholders' investment.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of shareholder value creation.

kpis.name: Regulatory Capital Ratios (Tier 1 and Total)
kpis.explanation: Measures a bank's financial strength and loss-absorption capacity relative to regulatory requirements.
kpis.description: Indicate a bank's ability to absorb potential losses while meeting regulatory standards.
kpis.signal: Essential measure for stability and regulatory compliance.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Amount of shares repurchased and retired by the company during the period.
kpis.description: No share repurchases were executed in 2024 and 2025, although an authorization for 5 million shares remains in place through July 2026.
kpis.signal: Indicates return of capital to shareholders or lack of investment opportunities.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 15.45 billion USD in the most recent year.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.02 billion USD in the most recent year.

kpis.name: Cumulative Shareholder Performance over 5 Years
kpis.explanation: Total return for shareholders over a five-year period, including stock price appreciation and reinvested dividends.
kpis.description: Compares the company's stock performance (90.86%) against the Russell 3000 index (185.47%) and S&P U.S. BMI Banks (211.47%) over a five-year period with dividend reinvestment.
kpis.signal: Measures long-term value creation for shareholders since December 2020.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant exposure to loans and investments, making it vulnerable to payment defaults. The ratio of allowance for credit losses to financed loans is 1.29% in 2025.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates can have a significant impact on the company's results, particularly on net interest income and net interest margin.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage its cash flows to meet its obligations. A decline in liquidity could create difficulties for the company.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the banking sector. Regulatory changes can impact the company's results.

risks.title: Competition Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, which can create pressure on net interest margins and fees. Competitors may offer similar products and services.

risks.title: Asset Management Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage its assets effectively to maximize returns. Poor asset management could result in losses.

risks.title: Asset Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may face losses from impairment of its assets, such as loans or investments.

ai_positioning.summary: FFIN does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K filing. There is no indication of AI use or integration in its operations or products.
